methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Ark Electronics is a private-sector company operating in Robotics & Manufacturing. The available comp universe consists of one public peer (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private peers, including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. The Robotics & Manufacturing sector contains ten same-sector peers overall.

The peer-median valuation method is not applicable to Ark Electronics. Despite identifying ten same-sector peers, filtering by stage, adjacent-stage characteristics, and valuation tier yielded fewer than three datapoints in any meaningful narrow category. A sector-wide median relying on all ten peers would conflate materially different company profiles and stages, introducing substantial noise into the estimate. Consequently, this triangulation approach cannot be responsibly applied.

Without sufficient narrowly-filtered peer data, stage-specific comparables, or disclosed financial metrics (revenue, EBITDA, growth rates), a quantitative valuation range cannot be derived from the available dataset. Key uncertainties preventing valuation synthesis include the absence of Ark Electronics' current stage classification, capital raised to date, financial performance, and the stage/valuation profile of most private peers in the comp set. A credible valuation would require either (1) expansion of disclosed peer financials within the narrow Robotics & Manufacturing space at similar development stages, or (2) internal operational and growth metrics from Ark Electronics itself.
